Title: S21 Read-Only Discovery
Description: Discover SAP BW metadata from S21 (Client 200) via read-only interfaces without triggering locks or loads
Acceptance_Criteria: System status, InfoAreas, ADSOs, and CompositeProviders cataloged without write operations

Title: Canonical Metadata Modeling
Description: Normalize diverse BW objects (ADSO, CP, Transformation, DTP) into target-agnostic schema
Acceptance_Criteria: All BW attributes mapped into JSON/CSN format with upstream and downstream lineage

Title: Four-Way Migration Strategy Evaluation
Description: Evaluate native Datasphere, BW Bridge, BDC Data Product Generator, and Hybrid routes
Acceptance_Criteria: Objective scoring matrix produces evidence-based recommendation per object

Title: Dependency & Blast Radius Analysis
Description: Calculate upstream extractor dependencies and downstream reporting/SAC impact
Acceptance_Criteria: Lineage graph generated with cycle detection and consumer blast radius score

Title: Deterministic Target Artifact Generation
Description: Generate Datasphere Local/Remote Tables, Views, Analytic Models, and CSN definitions
Acceptance_Criteria: CSN payload complies with Datasphere JSON schema and HANA Cloud SQL dialect

Title: S21 Zero-Modification Boundary
Description: Prevent any create, update, delete, or activate operation in SAP S21
Acceptance_Criteria: Zero HTTP POST/PUT/DELETE, zero CTS transports, zero DDIC writes

Title: Credential Isolation
Description: Keep real credentials out of Git and logs; use environment variables or OS credential manager
Acceptance_Criteria: .env.example contains only placeholders; .gitignore blocks secret files

Title: Sub-second Local Metadata Retrieval
Description: Local metadata repository queries must return in under 500ms for 1,000 objects
Acceptance_Criteria: SQLite indexed queries benchmarked and passing in test suite

Title: Automated Test Coverage
Description: Unit, parser, assessment, and contract tests must cover all core migration logic
Acceptance_Criteria: Test suite passing with 100% assertions verified
